docstring: Merges a list of half-open intervals [start, end) into non-overlapping contiguous intervals.
signature: def merge_overlapping_intervals(intervals: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
ref_test:
def test_merge_intervals():
    intervals = [(10, 20), (15, 25), (30, 40), (20, 22)]
    # (10, 20), (15, 25), (20, 22) merge into (10, 25)
    assert merge_overlapping_intervals(intervals) == [(10, 25), (30, 40)]
    assert merge_overlapping_intervals([]) == []
    assert merge_overlapping_intervals([(20, 10)]) == []
    # Disjoint intervals
    assert merge_overlapping_intervals([(1, 2), (3, 4)]) == [(1, 2), (3, 4)]
